Below it a woodcut ornament, then a large initial word "VNITA-" at right. Faint text in the margins and under the ornament is too faint to read and is not transcribed.

l.i: Vechta, sub Arctoi labitur arva poli.
Parvula dextrorsum deducis ab aequoris unde
Candida Mudeni postquam sub moenia cessit
Isala festinat proprii sub nominis arcem
Solis ab occasu nitido decurrit, ad Austrum
Vix ternenda manent veteris vestigia fossa
Vix tenui Rhenum fossa liquore vehit.
Vordina succurrit Rheno non adjicit undas
Sed famulis Rheni gaudet adesse labris.
Rhenum Leda capit, Ledao pulchrior ore
Leda dat extremum Catvico flumina Rheni
Rhenus, in Oceani desinit eger aquas.

page.notes: The verse lines are italic and mostly legible, but several words are blurred and may be misread. The woodcut ornament between the verse and the heading carries no text. The faint background text is not legible and was omitted.
